answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered dairy farmer milk record with dairy farmers verification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 654 aliases would need 654 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the lotus of the check, count the delta of the cost, and read the mesa of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
